hints.content: The hanger has equal weight on each side. Let's start by writing an expression for the weight on each side.
The left side of the hanger has one weight which weighs $16$ units.

The right side of the hanger has two weights, one of which weighs $\blueD{n}$ units and the other which weighs $10$ units.  

The right side of the hanger weighs $\blueD{n}+10$ units.

So, the hanger shows us $16=\blueD{n}+10$.

To get the $\blueD{n}$ alone and find out its weight, we need to take away $10$ units from the right side of the hanger.

To keep the hanger balanced, we need to take away $10$ from the left side of the hanger too.

$\blueD{n}=16-10=?$
